description: Output of the services (or of the last build with job: true), merged in time order, one line per entry: '<service> | <text>'.

env.description: Environment name; by default, the branch of the worktree (feat/login gives feat-login)

errors_only.description: Only lines reporting errors, with their stack traces

job.description: The log of the last job (build, start, seed) instead

path.description: Absolute path of the worktree; by default, the first root the client shares, else the directory the MCP server runs in

project.description: Project slug; by default, the project of .spawner/spawner.yaml

service.description: Service name; all services when absent

since.description: From a duration ago ("10m") or a date

name: spawner_logs
title: Service logs
